I am a PhD student in Renewable Energy at IER-UNAM and a mechatronics engineer. My research focuses on closed-loop control of solar heliostats using computer vision and complementary sensing methods, under the supervision of Dr. Camilo Arancibia. My experience includes instrumentation, embedded systems, IoT and data analysis with Python.


## Education
- PhD in Renewable Energy — IER-UNAM (2026-present)
- Master's in Engineering - Energy Area — IER-UNAM (2022-2025)
  - Thesis: IoT smartwatch based on open technologies for the collection of thermal comfort data. [View](publicaciones.html#tesis-reloj)
- B.Eng. in Mechatronics — Universidad Tecnológica de Emiliano Zapata (UTEZ) (2018–2020)

## Experience
- Teaching Assistant — IER-UNAM (2023-present). Current support for Solar Thermal Energy, particularly solar geometry.
- Physics and Mathematics Teacher — NC School (2024–2025)
- IoT Developer — IER-UNAM (2020 / 2024-present)
- General Coordinator of the National Congress of Renewable Energy Students (CNEER) 2026.

## Highlights
### Sensor-based feedback for heliostat control
I develop sensor-based feedback methods for closed-loop heliostat positioning, with primary emphasis on computer vision. I carry out experimental work with the heliostat, solar furnace and control system at IER-UNAM.
[Current research](proyectos.html#heliostato)


### IoT smartwatch for thermal comfort
Open design based on XIAO ESP32C3, MAX30102, GY‑906; LVGL UI and ThingsBoard backend.  
[Thesis](publicaciones.html#tesis-reloj) · [Article](publicaciones.html#articulo-reloj) · [Repository](https://github.com/JulioLanda4/IoT_Reloj_Confort)
